steps.step: G1.three family CAR modes (Jordan-Wigner) and their six Majoranas gamma_i, gamma'_i: exact CAR / Clifford relations
G2.J and J' form commuting su(2) + su(2) = Spin(4) inside the family Spin(6); on the four family lines both Casimirs = 3/4: the lines are (1/2, 1/2)
G3.diagonal SO(3): (1/2,1/2) = singlet + triplet; the singlet IS the family Fock vacuum (omitted line), the triplet is Lambda^2 C^3 (the three families)
G4.Weyl walk with the family spinor 2J on the four lines: unitary, eight bcc steps, isotropic ((k.2J)^2 = |k|^2); the deck quarter turn lifts to order 8 with fourth power -1 (mu8)
G5.KILL test: [U_F(k), P_vacuum] = O(k) != 0 (also for J'): free propagation with the family spinor mixes the omitted line with the three families -> family content changes kinetically

G6.(statement) TFPT's family Clifford structure contains a canonical spinor and reproduces the 3+1 family split as SO(3) vector + singlet, but as the propagation spinor it locks family number to momentum: the spacetime spinor must be internal-number-free (AX.SPINSTEP sharpened)
